scope: Révisions lisibles des PNJ de services 02–04 : armurier, secouriste et technicien ; mêmes identifiants, aucun nouveau service ou effet défini.

records.label: Armurier
records.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: revised full-body NPC appearance source for Project RL, a grim industrial cyberpunk roguelike, native 64px tiles.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: keep that service character's human identity, sex, hair, adult build and basic costume identity, while revising its readability and professional props as described. Input image 2 is ONLY a style reference for clean bold comic contours, large flat material masses and restrained shading. Do NOT copy the cultist's hood, mask, uniform, baton or pose.
Style: compact mature adult game proportions, around five heads tall, matching the accepted humans' standing height. Broad flat shapes, ONE clear shadow per material, very few purposeful lines. No fine cloth polygon patchwork, wear flecks, little buckles, tiny seams, dense straps, armor panel clutter or photographic texture. Strong natural hand/prop connection.
Composition: ONE complete standing character, nearly frontal and slightly viewed from above, head, hands, equipment and boot soles fully inside generous true ALPHA transparent margins. No background, ground, contact shadow, glow, text, symbols, alternate views or other figures. Dark calm industrial setting expressed through clothes and attitude only. Static appearance proposal; no new game service, powers, statistics or effects.
Subject: revise the stocky middle-aged male ARMORER of image 1. Retain his short greying hair/beard, stern tired face and raised amber work goggles. Broader shoulders and short practical stance, intact normal human anatomy.
Keep a broad dark TEAL work shirt, rolled sleeves and ONE heavy charcoal leather APRON ending near knees. Plain muted grey work trousers and heavy dark steel-toed boots. Two main large garment masses are teal and charcoal; amber goggles are a small accent. Remove the many bright straps, pale armor patches and segmented guards. One plain belt and a single apron pocket are enough.
Both large dark work gloves hold ONE short dark-steel FIREARM RECEIVER/BARREL ASSEMBLY horizontally across the lower chest and upper apron. It is an unfinished angular compact rifle mechanism with a short barrel pointing to viewer LEFT, held down and safely, without aiming or combat pose. The LEFT glove supports the rear receiver from below, the RIGHT glove wraps under the forward barrel assembly. Both normal-length elbows bent naturally, two clearly attached gloves. Expose teal shirt shoulders and much of the apron below it. ONE broad dull steel plane makes the part visible against apron. No muzzle light, ammunition belts, holstered guns or other weapons. This prop shows a craftsperson's work; it creates no weapon model or repair mechanic.
